notes.title: What's Taking So Freaking Long!?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I understand how not seeing a game update in months leads to the assumption that the project is dead, but rest assured this one is [i]not[/i]!
[previewyoutube=DkgUO_7jGrA;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40111423/f1b9dbe98af291a34ab3d64a6937f5c5d278ad1b.png[/img]

The next update is going to include a boss fight that starts with the helicopter seen above, which leads to the player descending the stairs in the building below before confronting the pilot a final time. I have the map for the helicopter fight mostly completed, but here's where my ideas begin to diverge.
[previewyoutube=SClfQ6ZxtLY;full][/previewyoutube]

Part of the problem is that some of the ideas I had (and even started working on) would create changes that would simply be too drastic and fundamentally different to introduce so late in the game.

[h2]Here are the ideas I scrapped, and why they were scrapped:[/h2]

Weapon Upgrades: I originally thought about upgrading the player's katana after defeating the helicopter, I started tinkering with upgrades to the katana and cyberpunch before it dawned on me that there was no use introducing such a mechanic when the player was over halfway through the campaign (60-75% of quests/missions would be completed by this point, depending on ending). I then considered implementing this system earlier in the game, but doing so would completely change pacing with any attack speed and katana dash speed increases, and all the weapons are high enough damage that increasing the amount would have no visible effect.

Leveling system: I thought about turning the game fully into an RPG, continuing to use Karma as experience and leveling up the player when they reach a certain amount, with the amount required to reach the next level increasing from each previous level (like XP in most RPGs). I didn't feel this would work because I want the player to lose karma in combat, and karma to affect the end game result (spoiler alert). I also don't want to have to fluff the game with pointless quests and force the player to grind to feel any sort of progression.

[h2]Here are the ideas I'll definitely be keeping:[/h2]

[b]One more weapon[/b]: I know what I said about late game introductions, but I've had this in mind as a final weapon for a while, and it's going to be [i]so op[/i]!

[b]Six Endings[/b]: Three ending scenarios, each with a positive and negative outcome.

[b]New Game+[/b] mode: One of the good endings will allow endless freeroam, and from endless freeroam there will be a portal to New Game+ mode, which retains player inventory but resets the storyline.

[h2]Here are the ideas I'm still debating:[/h2]
I do want the player to have [b]increased speed[/b] while "chasing" the helicopter pilot, but only until reaching the boss fight. I want it to feel like Unit 6617 is so determined to catch the pilot that adrenaline is making you faster. I haven't decided if attacks should be slightly faster, how much the base run speed should be increased, or how fast the katana dash should be and how long it should last.

I'm debating adding [b]another stage with miniguns[/b] to the helicopter fight, but I'll admit that during testing the rocket launcher phase might be difficult enough on its own!

[h2]What I'm still waiting on:[/h2]
I notified the actor who's playing the next boss last month that I was ready to take photos for sprites and record voice lines, and we're hoping to accomplish that within the next few weeks!

[h2]What our current roadmap looks like:[/h2]

[b]Early Q3 2025[/b]: Beta launch, singleplayer campaign complete

[b]2026[/b]: Multiplayer Mode Launch

[b]Thanks for all your continued support, happy holidays, and we'll see you in 2025![/b]

notes.title: Intermediary Patch - Several Fixes
notes.content:
Implementation of several improvements to base gameplay and bug fixes made while working on new content. If you want to sneak a peak at one the of upcoming maps open the console "~" and enter "map MAP27" ;)

+Fixed bug allowing player to bypass boss fight
+Fixed door texture on first level
+Made ally ninjas green
+Bus crash now visible from outside
+Significant Decrease in Usable Limb Drops
+Fixed blocking bug that kept player invincible and unnoticed when entering a new stage after blocking
+Fixed tutorial ninja not giving player karma
+Increased fire damage radius
+Added ability to dash with katana and made horizontal slicing easier
+New secret on second level!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/6Pm4hKs/John2.png[/img]

[b]Lab Rats[/b] are experiments John made, they act as stationary turrets and are disabled with a killswitch:
